newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer names Schineis head of Atomic.
newsitem.headline: Amer names Schineis head of Atomic.

text.p: Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said in a statement on Friday Michael Schineis, 37, was appointed new head of its Atomic ski equipment manufacturing unit from the end of October.
Schineis follows recently appointed Amer group president and CEO Roger Talermo as Atomic president, Amer said.
"Schineis ... has considerable experience in winter sports industry, as General Manager of Salomon GmbH based in Munich," it said.
Atomic, based in Altenmarkt, Austria, had 1995 net sales of 670 million markka.
Amer is reorganising its Wilson and Atomic business groups to improve profitability.
